paragraphs.text: Devin2API model provider for DeepSeek Harness
**A model-provider plugin that brings devin-2api-lite into DeepSeek Harness.**
English | 中文
Quick start · Configuration · Web UI · Protocol · Troubleshooting

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The plugin is the **client half**. devin-2api-lite owns the Devin
> protocol, catal
og, quota and upstream token. Start the gateway first: without it the plugin advertises no models an

ream token. Start the gateway first: without it the plugin advertises no models and
> cannot stream.
## What it is
`dsh-devin2api` registers the provider route **`devin2api`** in DeepSeek Harness. It reads the catal

og from
`GET /v1/models`, streams `POST /v1/chat/completions` as DSH `StreamChunk`s, and contributes

a settings page, per-model
switches and a quota pill to the Web UI.

- streaming text, reasoning and tool calls, with stable error codes;
- current-turn images as resize

d, byte-capped data URLs;
- allowlists and per-model visibility applied live.
| Gateway endpoint | Caller | Credential |

| `GET /healthz` | settings panel | none |
| `GET /v1/models` | catalog, discovery | Host `Bearer`;

browser none |
| `GET /v1/quota` | quota pill, panel | browser none |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions`

| every model call | `Bearer` |
| `POST /__clientlog` | diagnostics | none, local |
## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness** 0.2.x (tested `0.2.1-rc.3`); peers `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm >= 0.1.5-rc.1`,
`@de

epseek-ai/schemastery >= 3.18.0`.
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **devin-2api-lite** with `
/v1/quota` and CORS on read-only GETs; the Host `attachments` service for images.

## Configuration
Everything lives under `providers.devin2api`:
| Field | Default | Notes |

| `displayName` | `Devin2API` | Provider name in the selector |
| `baseURL` | `http://127.0.0.1:1808

9/v1` | Gateway root including `/v1` |
| `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` | `''` / `DEVIN2API_API_KEY` | Direc

t key (redacted) or env var read per request |
| `enabled` | `true` | Mount-time gate; changing it n

eeds a reload |
| `models` | `[]` | Empty = all. Non-empty allowlist of ids or `{ id, name }` |
| `m

odelVisibility` | `{}` | Per-model switch; `false` hides a model |
| `images` | `true` | Declare ima

ge input for vision models |
| `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` | `262144` / `128000` | The window come
s per model from `/v1/models` `context_length` (fallback here); `maxTokens` is the global output res

ervation |
| `modelMaxTokens` | `{ "swe-2": 65536 }` | Per-model output reservation (id or family pr

efix). SWE-2's 262k window with a 128k reservation would compact at ~26% |
| `refreshMinutes` | `5`

| Catalog cache TTL (minimum 1) |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Per-request timeout including th

e stream |
| `imagePixelBudget` / `imageMaxBytes` | `4194304` / `1048576` | Resize target per image

|
| `maxRequestImageBytes` | `20971520` | Total base64 characters per request |
All fields except `enabled` are volatile: settings writes apply live. `DEVIN2API_BASE_URL` is report

ed to the Models
page as an endpoint hint.
## Web UI
_The real Settings → Devin2API page and the composer pill (UI copy is Chinese). Full-size settings._

- **Settings → Devin2API** — gateway status, daily/weekly quota, catalog switches and refresh.
- **S

ettings → Models → Devin2API** — base URL, key, images, model discovery.
- **Composer pill** — only
for a `devin2api` model; 60 s poll; click to request `?fresh=1`.
The browser calls `/healthz`, `/v1/models` and `/v1/quota` directly and sends **no** API key. With `

auth.api_key`
set, the catalog/panel reads fail (chat still works); read-only settings disable the s

_key`
set, the catalog/panel reads fail (chat still works); read-only settings disable the switches.
## Catalog and images
- The catalog is cached for `refreshMinutes`, refreshed in a single flight, and falls back to `model

s`; if both are
empty it reports `EMPTY_CATALOG`.
- `models` is an allowlist; `modelVisibility` is a

pplied after it. All-off or all-missing falls back to the full list.
- Only the current turn (last `

user` message onward) is uploaded. Older images become `[Image omitted from history]`.
- Images are
resized per `imagePixelBudget`/`imageMaxBytes`; over `maxRequestImageBytes` fails with `IMAGE_BUDGET
sized per `imagePixelBudget`/`imageMaxBytes`; over `maxRequestImageBytes` fails with `IMAGE_BUDGET`.
## Protocol mapping
| DSH input | Gateway request |

| system prompt + leading/mid-history `system` | one or more `system` messages |
| `developer` | `sy

stem` |
| user / tool content | string, or `text` + `image_url` parts |
| assistant text / tool call

s | `content` + `tool_calls` (JSON-string arguments) |
| tools | OpenAI `function` tools; `deferLoad

ing` skipped |
| `maxTokens` / `reasoningEffort` / `temperature` / `stop` | same-named fields |
Stream: `reasoning_content` → reasoning block, `content` → text, `tool_calls` → tool-call block, `us

age` → usage,
`finish_reason` → `stop` / `tool-calls` / `max-tokens`. `[DONE]` ends the stream.
Errors: `AUTH`, `QUOTA`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `TIMEOUT`, `ABORTED`, `TRANSPORT`, `SERVER`, `IMAGE_BUDG

ET`,
`IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE`, `EMPTY_CATALOG`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `UPSTREAM_ERROR`.
> Current lite fixes sampling (`max_tokens`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) and ignores client val

ues; the plugin
> still forwards `temperature` / `stop` for gateways that honor them.

## Troubleshooting

- **`cannot reach the gateway`** — `curl /healthz`, check `baseURL`; the Host must reach it too.
- *

*`AUTH`** — check `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` against lite's `auth.api_key`.
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- No replay state; multi-turn replays visible text and tool calls only.
- One gateway per plugin ins

tance.
- `enabled` requires a reload.
- The browser UI is unauthenticated; use a loopback gateway wi

th `auth.api_key` unset.
- UI copy is Chinese-only.
- `contextWindow` is discovered per model from t
he gateway's `context_length` (newer lite builds); models without it fall back to the configured val
ue. `maxTokens` stays configured, with a bundled `modelMaxTokens` override for `swe-2` (64k) — the g
ateway exposes no per-model output cap.
